paras: Barisia jonesi, also known commonly as the imbricate alligator lizard, Jones' imbricate alligator lizard, and el escorpión de Jones in Mexican Spanish, is a species of medium-sized lizard in the family Anguidae. The species is endemic to Mexico.
The specific name, jonesi, is in honor of American biologist Richard Evan Jones.
B. jonesi is found in the Mexican state of Michoacán.
